metadata.description: Curated demo subset of the fresh protocol-v2 ban pool (Qwen3-8B-FP8 generations, T=1.0, thinking off): 100 of 200 runs, 10 per (task, template), each template's label mix kept. Every run carries the exp3-fitted readout scores at layer 27, position k_pre (score > 0 means 'predicts the banned algorithm').

source.method_name: Reading a coding ban inside the model (descriptive readouts, Qwen3-8B)

metadata.readout_position: k_pre (residual state at the token just before the first algorithm-identifying token)

score_methods.sae_top1: single top SAE latent (Qwen-Scope W64K, k=50), sign-corrected activation
score_methods.sae_top20_lr: logistic probe on the top-20 SAE latents
score_methods.raw_dim: difference-of-means (DiM) direction on the raw residual stream: H @ w - mid
score_methods.raw_lr: logistic probe on the full raw residual stream
score_methods.neuron_top20_lr: logistic probe on the top-20 raw dimensions
score_methods.sae_code_dim: DiM direction on the SAE code

sae_transfer_test.rule: PASS(L) := dCE_inst(L) <= 1.5 x dCE_base(L) (spliced-in CE over response tokens)
